# GradientTopologyOptimization

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework that applies gradient-based optimization methods to the design and tuning of network topologies, treating the network structure as a differentiable parameter space. This enables automated, data-driven discovery of optimal network architectures for TCC/iNEST systems, replacing manual or heuristic topology design.
